## Objective

Deliver consistent reusable, Template and active-root capability with usable documentation.

## Scope

- Declare and verify source-to-Template distribution
- Publish the reusable capability into the Template
- Adopt the exact packages into the active depot
- Document setup, adoption and recovery routes

## Entry conditions

- Module and initializer behavior are ready for mapped distribution.

## Exit criteria

- Template and active-root packages match the manifest and documentation reflects actual interfaces.

## Risks

- The Template is updater-owned; root adoption remains exact and unrelated projects stay untouched.
